notes.title: Spontaneous Fountain Bugfix
notes.content:
Second bugfix update! Just one small little intimidating bug that had to be dealt with this time!

[list]
[*]Due to a slight oversight, Desire accidentally had the ability to become the all-powerful girlboss she truly deserves to be - namely by spawning fountains underneath herself to sit on even when the nearest fountain is in a whole different cell. Unfortunately, to prevent intimidating more players, I had to take that power away from her from the time being.
[/list]

TL;DR, Desire will no longer sit on reality-breaking fountains while in the wish garden.

notes.title: First set of Tweaks and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
I'm glad this game hasn't set fire to anyone's house yet so we're doing good! There have been a few small fixes and changes implemented now we're in the first week after demo release.

[list]
[*]What you've all been waiting for! The floor in the first area is now 40% more floor! Aka it will stick around a couple of seconds longer for the platforming puzzles - no more elite gaming skills required to walk!
[*]Glitch fixed where you could make a lovely dab into a wall, die and then trap him there for all eternity.
[*]Small bit of jank fixed in the bean bag chair's collision box - you still have to wiggle to get out of it just like a real one!
[*]Tracy now only strafes during combat if you've unlocked the Love Bite - to prevent unexpected moonwalking.
[/list] 

Thanks for sticking around and giving feedback! I can't wait for you all to see all the little secrets hidden in this demo! 

Stay tuned!
